name: Wilkins-Chalgren Anaerobe Broth (N2/CO2) (DSMZ 339a)
description: DSMZ culture medium 339a (complex). Contains undefined components (Distilled water, Sodium resazurin, dehydrated Wilkins-Chalgren medium) rendered as a labeled in-silico hydrolysate approximation. Defined compounds mapped to BiGG (g/L->mM via molar mass); salts dissociated to ion exchanges.

provenance.citation: MediaDive (Koblitz J et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2023), aggregating DSMZ medium 339a: WILKINS-CHALGREN ANAEROBE BROTH (N2/CO2).
provenance.notes: Presence-based uptake bounds; recipe_g_l + concentration_mM retained. Undefined hydrolysates approximated as amino acids + nucleosides + vitamins (labeled).
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.doi == '10.1093/nar/gkac803' (MediaDive database paper) and citation contains 'MediaDive'
provenance.citation_original: DSMZ MediaDive (Koblitz J et al., Nucleic Acids Res 2023); DSMZ Medium 339a: WILKINS-CHALGREN ANAEROBE BROTH (N2/CO2).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
